dedupe_keys.name: grid to grid model estimates of daily mean river flow for gauged catchments in great britain 1960 to 2015 observed driving data marius g2g morecs daily

description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes MaRIUS-G2G-MORECS-daily to support drought and water-scarcity research. It contains daily mean river-flow estimates in cubic metres per second for 260 catchments in Great Britain during 1960–2015. The Grid-to-Grid hydrological model was driven by CEH-GEAR rainfall and MORECS potential evaporation. Catchments correspond to National River Flow Archive gauging stations. The EIDC landing record provides CSV access and supporting documentation under the UKCEH Click-Through Licence. Permitted personal or internal business use is royalty free; redistribution and products for financial gain are restricted. The download instructions show account authentication, which was not used. These are naturalised model outputs, not direct gauge measurements or complete operational water-supply records. That limitation matters when testing abstractions or regulation. Modellers could use the series as baseline inflows in water-supply and drought simulations. The deposit complements the longer Oudin-driven MaRIUS reconstruction by using a different potential-evaporation input and a shorter period.
name: Grid-to-Grid model estimates of daily mean river flow for gauged catchments in Great Britain (1960 to 2015): observed driving data [MaRIUS-G2G-MORECS-daily]
